reason: Reviewed the complete batch, approved scope, page prerequisites, and actual supplier claims and proofs. The claims and prerequisite uses are otherwise supported; one proof step misidentifies the target of a kernel inclusion.

findings.reason: Proof step 7.1 says the inclusion of K = ker Ψ is into Ψ’s finite free target, but K is a subsheaf of Ψ’s domain O_{Δ'}^{q(d+1)}. The matrix-kernel argument requires inclusion into that domain. Correcting “target” to “domain” or “source” resolves this proof-local defect without changing the statement.
